correctness.rationale: For every ordered list of cycle lengths, explicit enumeration of disjoint oriented cycles gives (n)_K/prod k_i and independent f/g edge agreement gives (s_n/n)^K. Uniform exponential domination of compact-support cycle-functional expansions and (n)_K/n^K -> exp(-S^2/2) prove critical convergence; delta sqrt(n)->infinity yields the Poisson functional. The covariance and extreme-value formula follow by factorial moments and uniform tails. The included exact-rational verifier enumerated 50068 maps and passed 115 identities. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The model gives a natural stability question for periodic orbits of a random functional digraph under independently refreshed outgoing edges. It identifies the dimensionless noise window delta sqrt(n), distinguishes a non-Poisson mesoscopic shared-orbit process from a Poisson short-orbit process, computes strictly negative cross-size dependence at the critical scale, and gives explicit largest-surviving-cycle distributions. These are meaningful joint structural statistics not determined by marginal cycle counts or the standard unthinned longest-cycle law.
